ln:4462832073.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist.

Business: Group Functions Technology L3

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead technical design discussions, document decisions and trade-offs, mentor engineers, and provide hands-on code reviews while working closely with architecture, data, platform, security, and product teams.
  • Integrate LLM/GenAI capabilities (e.g., RAG, prompt/agent patterns) into business workflows, ensuring outputs are reproducible, testable, explainable where required, and suitable for audit/review.
  • Design, build, test, and operate scalable, reliable backend services and APIs (primarily Python/FastAPI), evolving a proof of concept into a secure production capability.
  • Define stable API contracts and integration patterns for internal/external consumers, with clear versioning, documentation, and backwards-compatibility where required.
  • Create clean technical boundaries between product-specific functionality and reusable platform capabilities to enable reuse across multiple consumers.
  • Design and implement data ingestion and integration pipelines to validate, transform, enrich, and publish domain data using batch and event-driven patterns.
  • Implement pipeline controls for data quality, reconciliation, idempotency, retries, error handling, recovery, lineage, metadata, and provenance.
  • Build and maintain knowledge/retrieval capabilities over domain data (e.g., metadata/semantic models, knowledge graphs or equivalent), enabling trusted querying and interpretation.
  • Embed production engineering practices: automated testing (unit/integration/contract/E2E), observability (logs/metrics/traces/alerts/dashboards), resilience, secrets/configuration management, and incident/problem resolution.
  • Significant senior backend engineering experience delivering and operating production services.
  • Strong Python skills and experience with modern API frameworks such as FastAPI; strong REST API design including contract design and versioning.
  • Hands-on experience integrating GenAI/LLMs into applications (e.g., RAG, retrieval, prompt lifecycle management, evaluation/quality assurance) and familiarity with knowledge modelling (knowledge graphs/ontologies/semantic models) or equivalent approaches.
  • Solid distributed-systems fundamentals and service integration patterns (sync/async), with experience building reusable modules/capabilities.
  • Strong relational database and SQL skills: data modelling, schema migrations, and query performance tuning; experience handling structured and semi-structured data.
  • Proven experience designing and building data pipelines (batch and/or event-driven), including orchestration/scheduling, retries, idempotency, validation, and recovery.
  • Strong understanding of data quality and trust controls: reconciliation, data contracts, schema evolution, lineage, metadata, and provenance.
  • Cloud-native engineering experience: containers, Kubernetes, and CI/CD; ability to integrate with platform/infrastructure services.
  • Security engineering experience: authentication/authorization, secure service-to-service communication, secrets handling, and secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Production ownership mindset with strong observability and support practices (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, incident investigation).
  • Comfortable leading design discussions, communicating trade-offs clearly, and working collaboratively across engineering, architecture, data, security, and platform teams in a regulated environment.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of CCSS Representative II.

Principal responsibilities

Impact on the Business

  • Handles contacts with our HSBC customers in a polite and friendly way, instilling customer confidence and resolving customer’s issues at first contact where possible.
  • Delivers what is promised in line with customer expectations.
  • Offers value added products and services based on customer needs analysis and ensures customer understanding of those products.
  • 日常工作包括通过电话联系客户或相关部门获取资料信息，进行客户筛选及风险评估；
  • 建立与保持良好的客户关系并改善客户服务质素；
  • 按规定时间完成分配的任务，紧跟公司程序监控工作流程。

Requirements

  • Must have education standard to at least high school diploma and be of a legal working age；
  • Must be proficient in language(s) required by the process；
  • Open to working flexible shifting schedules；
  • Must be flexible, customer centric and have the ability to thrive in a team environment seeking feedback and open to development；
  • Takes pride in delivering what is promised in line with the customer and service expectations；
  • Wants to do a good job,is concerned about getting it right for the customer and checks everything is in order；
  • Ability to work in a high-volume, fast paced environment is required；
  • Proficiency with personal computers and basic software packages and specialised applications；
  • Excellent communication skills and is polite and friendly at all times；
  • Displays patience and empathy.
  • 大学本科以上及1年以上金融或会计相关工作经验;
  • 熟悉金融工具或投资相关的产品和术语以及基金的运营服务;
  • 具备良好的中英文阅读及写作能力;
  • 掌握基本的计算机技能（例如微软办公软件），打字速度快;
  • 口齿清晰，粤语，普通话及英语流利，有较强的沟通能力;
  • 能对客户的疑难问题展开调查并解决，或根据情况提出合理方案，向客户提供专业及优质的服务;
  • 恪守汇丰集团的合规要求和环球标准，具备高度责任感.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4466392915.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

This role is to fully support, configure, maintain and upgrade networks in China.

  • Configure and maintain switches, routers, and firewalls for the corporate LAN, including VLAN segmentation, trunk ports, and ACL rules.
  • Set up and maintain on‑premise security services such as FW, IDS/IPS, and network‑segmentation controls to protect internal assets.
  • Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot wireless access points to guarantee coverage, capacity and security across offices.
  • Provision and manage DHCP/DNS services to ensure reliable address allocation and name resolution for all on‑premise hosts.

Job Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

  • Install new network hardware and ensure continuous network connectivity.
  • Conduct regular network‑inventory reviews (labeling, rack diagrams, cable‑map updates) to keep the physical infrastructure orderly and traceable.
  • Coordinate with the data‑center (DC) and facilities team on power, cooling, and rack‑space planning to ensure network equipment operates within recommended environmental limits.
  • Maintain accurate LAN‑topology diagrams and configuration backups in the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) for disaster‑recovery and audit purposes.
  • Respond promptly to network‑related incident tickets, communicate incident impact and resolution status to business owners, management and, when required, to external audits or regulators.
  • Work with relevant project teams to specify system requirements and design network solutions for China.
  • Coordinate with local IT stakeholders and implement / enforce port‑security policies to prevent unauthorized device connections.
  • Follow up with local regulators to ensure compliance with all legal‑ and regulatory‑audit requirements, especially those related to IT security.
  • Manage vendors for network service providers and circuit carriers (including CT, CU, CM, other regulator recommended solution providers).
  • Perform other duties as assigned, consistent with your capabilities and the business’ needs.

Contributing Responsibilities

  • Contribute for implementing audit recommendations as per the agreed timeline.

Job Requirements

  • At least 5 years relevant working experience.
  • Good knowledge on Change and Incident management.
  • Cisco, FortiGate; F5 network certification preferred.
  • Fluent in English and Mandarin (spoken and written).
  • Experience in resolving network security incidents and breaches.
  • Experience testing and planning the deployment of router and switch platforms.
  • In-depth knowledge of Data Centre design principles, products and protocols.
  • Extensive technical experience (Support and Design) using many of following: Cisco Routers, Switch, Nexus, ASR, ISR product lines, Checkpoint and FortiGate Firewalls, F5 load balance.
  • Technical experience with OSPF, IBGP/EBGP Eigrp network routing protocol.
  • Extensive experience with management, internetworking design and implementation of networks.
  • Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • Good project management skills (large network deployment and cross-discipline project deliverables).
  • The ability to work under pressure, as well as provide network support outside of business hours.
  • The ability to work independently or as part of a team.
  • Skills and knowledge on VoIP solutions such as Cisco UC product line.
  • Analytical and problem-solving capabilities in order to execute voice, video and audio infrastructure technology.

ln:4467041717.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening

up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Be responsible for successful implementation of Premier Acquisition strategies
  • Acquire new-to-bank customers via central or self-generated leads.
  • In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to complete simple retail sales.
  • Development of strong working relationships with relevant business areas (e.g., WPB, Marketing, etc)
  • Delivery high standard customer service to meet customer satisfactory

Qualifications - External

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of one year proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
  • Sound knowledge of various forms of deposits, WEM product, mortgage, etc.
  • Knowledge of the constantly changing laws/regulations governing banks/finance industry, consumer trends, competitor offerings, economic and foreign currency markets
  • Strong presentation and sales skills
  • Objection handling techniques and work under pressure
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Customer service orientation
  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
  • Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

www.hsbc.com.cn/careers

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. /FF

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4486909830.descriptionHtml:
Description:

Citi Research delivers industry-leading investment analysis to Citi’s global institutional investor and wealth management client base. Our team includes some 350 publishing analysts globally, with fundamental coverage of ~3,600 equity securities, as well as areas such as quantitative analysis, economics, fixed-income/rates/credit, FX, commodities, and data analytics. We also deliver access services such as conferences & events, corporate access & visits, and direct insights from market, policy, and industry experts.

Citi Research is seeking a Supervisory Analyst / Editor / Designated Quality Review Officer (DQRO) to join our nascent Shanghai-based Research office under Citigroup Securities (China) Co. Ltd. This is a role for a seasoned professional combining responsibilities in editorial, risk management, and operational processes. This role will primarily support and review research product produced by our new Shanghai team, both in English and Chinese. The role may also involve some review of global ex-PRC research product. The role requires strong editorial skills and financial/investment topics comprehension in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Attention to detail is a must!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Review investment research product to ensure compliance with PRC and US FINRA regulations, including reasonable basis and sourcing requirements.
  • Review investment research product to ensure compliance with Citi’s internal research content guidelines, as detailed in our research guidebooks and policies.
  • Edit investment research for quality, clarity, commerciality, style, and grammar.
  • Review both Chinese and English variants, including cross-checking consistency.
  • Review investment research language/tone and content for franchise risk, with consideration of the firm's reputation and business exposures, and in light of PRC and global political and client sensitivities. Be capable of editing to mitigate such risks (while maintaining our independent views), as well as determining when escalation is appropriate.
  • Handle the checking of investment research product for 1) issuer mentions for cross-checking against our Watch List; 2) the inclusion of appropriate disclaimers & disclosures; 3) data consistency; and 4) distribution tagging and other product & template elements.
  • Act as an editorial project manager, providing end-to-end traffic management of work-in-progress, liaising as needed with analyst teams, other Publications staff, product managers, control & compliance teams, data and technical support teams, and other relevant partners, to resolve problems and ensure product ultimately publishes. Additional managerial responsibilities may be assigned, given the need for flexibility in the small startup team.
  • Broadly as a Citi staffer, assess risk appropriately when business decisions are made, work in compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to policies, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

  • Have passed the examination uniformly organized by the CSRC for securities business personnel; Securities Association of China (SAC) test.
  • Holding a FINRA Series-16 license is a major advantage. We may also consider strong candidates without Series-16 and would sponsor them to sit the exam, including providing study materials. Quick study prep time and then successfully passing this challenging exam is a requirement for the role.
  • Candidate should have at least five years of experience creating, supporting, or editing investment/financial analytic content. Candidate should be a fluent Chinese and English speaker with evidence of editorial and writing capability.
  • We expect candidates to have strong familiarity with financial markets, financial terminology, and ongoing business news in PRC, Asia, and globally.
  • Ability to prioritize and to juggle multiple tasks simultaneously amid tight deadlines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to exercise sound and balanced judgment.
  • Meticulous and detail oriented. Key aspects of the role involve being able to remember and apply many guidelines and procedures on a consistent and reliable basis.
  • Team members should have comfort working with sometimes complex publishing software platforms (e.g. Sinitek) and ability to coordinate with partner teams when trouble-shooting technical issues.
  • Team player with good interpersonal skills, and the patience and diplomacy to work with demanding internal customers and effectively find win-win solutions.

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

|CSTC|HQCT|C13|YIN|GLN|LP|WY

Other Key Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s undergraduate university degree or higher
  • PRC nationality
  • Have complete civil capacity; be of good moral character, fair-minded and honest, and possess sound professional ethics.
  • Have not incurred any criminal penalty or any serious administrative penalty related to securities or futures business.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Management.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead portfolio planning, prioritisation, governance and delivery oversight across all Value Streams, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and agreed outcomes.
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with key business, IT lead, COO and senior management stakeholders, ensuring alignment, collaboration and clear communication.
  • Provide comprehensive financial oversight, including budget tracking, forecasting, scenario analysis and variance management. Identify trends and recommend appropriate actions to support investment decisions.
  • Lead workforce capacity planning, identify resource and capability gaps, and support data-driven prioritisation and allocation decisions.
  • Deliver accurate and timely management reporting and data analytics. Use approved AI tools to generate actionable insights, improve efficiency and support effective decision-making.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for GPDM, Pioneer, Apptio, Looker, Copilot and other relevant tools. Promote consistent adoption of HSBC tools, standards and processes through effective monitoring, training, guidance and ongoing support.
  • Provide timely and effective ad hoc support to the Global Head as required, coordinating relevant inputs and driving actions through to completion.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in portfolio, programme, project, delivery or business management within a complex global organisation.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and IT teams.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Experience in financial and workforce planning, resource management and data-driven prioritisation.
  • Good knowledge of reporting and analytics tools, such as GPDM, Pioneer, Apptio, Looker and Copilot, with a willingness to learn and explore emerging AI-enabled tools to enhance analysis, reporting, forecasting and productivity.
  • A proactive, collaborative and delivery-focused approach, with the ability to manage competing priorities and respond effectively to ad hoc requests.
  • Commitment to HSBC’s values, risk management principles and responsible use of data and AI.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

ln:4490722232.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited
